result.question: What was Tesla's total revenue in fiscal year 2025?
result.answer: Tesla's total revenue in fiscal year 2025 was $94,827 million (approximately $94.8 billion), as reported in the Consolidated Statements of Operations in Tesla's 10-K filing for the year ended December 31, 2025 [0001628280-26-003952:item-8-p007]. This figure is also confirmed by the XBRL-tagged revenue fact of 94,827,000,000 USD for the period ending December 31, 2025 [xbrl:0001628280-26-003952:us-gaap:Revenues:2025-12-31]. This total was composed of automotive sales of $65,821 million, automotive regulatory credits of $1,993 million, automotive leasing of $1,712 million, energy generation and storage revenue of $12,771 million, and services and other revenue of $12,530 million [0001628280-26-003952:item-8-p007]. This represented a decrease from $97,690 million in fiscal year 2024 [0001628280-26-003952:item-8-p007].
